43% win rate over 118 trades and the account is up $3,412.60. Profit factor 1.61 is where
that comes from — the winners are bigger than the losers, so being right less than half the
time is enough. Win rate on its own tells you almost nothing. Product example: these figures
illustrate the feature, not real trader results.

Slow sessions are where good weeks get given back. Nothing is setting up, so the bar for
"close enough" quietly drops. Count how many of your trades were taken in the dead hours —
that number usually settles the argument.

47 wins against 30 losses reads as 61.0%, and it still says nothing about whether the account
grew. A 61% hit rate with an average loser twice the size of the average winner is a losing
system. The distribution is the starting point, not the answer. Product example: these figures
illustrate the feature, not real trader results.
